blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several red flags were raised in the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) proposed budget for 2027, particularly in infrastructure projects like farm-to-market roads whose grid coordinates were found in dubious locations, including Benham Rise and the Celebes Sea. During a Senate hearing, People’s Budget Coalition Ken Abante warned of a possible repeat of the flood control scandal concerning 7,000 infrastructure projects worth P190 billion inserted by the House of Representatives in the DA’s budget for 2027. Among these projects were P23 million worth of farm-to-market roads (FMRs) whose coordinates, which were supposed to be in Nueva Ecija, were found […]...
